refusal: honoured in full; a refusal is a valid outcome
unverified: no results from the control arm yet — the arms exist and are published, no report has been analysed
the notice and the effect list share an author, so the described effect and the actual effect are not separable from the artifact alone
the taker cannot be blinded: a blank is visibly blank to anyone who decodes it, so expectancy is measured rather than removed
